scope: Independent applicability review of the 16 specifically requested findings across seven immutable snapshots.
method: Read-only git source/diff and tree metadata inspection; targeted independent reading of relevant source ranges and complete narrow correction hunks; identical whole blobs share findings. Existing full-file review coverage is supplied by unified-coverage.json.
runtime_execution: No application source, target tests, analyzers, scanners, browser, payloads, live endpoints, or transactions were executed. No target source or repository documents were changed.
coverage_claim: This matrix contributes exact-snippet applicability revalidation, not additional whole-file coverage or runtime testing.

status_legend.affected: The specific defect is present in an inspected application path, subject to the stated conditions; confirmed by source, not execution.
status_legend.fixed: The inspected immutable snapshot contains the source correction for this row. This does not mean deployed, merged elsewhere, runtime-tested, or comprehensively secure.
status_legend.not-present: The defect-specific implementation/contract is absent. This does not imply equivalent newer functionality or a backported fix.
status_legend.conditional: The code gap remains at a malformed direct-runtime-input or caller/environment boundary; normal production reachability has not been established.
status_legend.partial: A subset is corrected; the remaining condition is explicitly stated in the cell.

findings.title: Idle lock retains ordinary authority
findings.condition: Loaded seller keys reach idle expiry. Ordinary authority is not synchronously revoked while custody is checked; if there is no verified recoverable copy, keys remain usable through ordinary secret APIs.
findings.impact_limit: This is a local session-authority lifecycle gap. Fixed snapshots deliberately preserve narrow encrypted-backup recovery for a sole copy; that retained recovery is not an additional ordinary-session bypass.

findings.title: Archived receipt issue date exceeds Date range
findings.condition: An authenticated same-seller/same-chain reconciliation archive contains a positive safe-integer issuedAt outside the representable JavaScript Date range in seconds, and the receipt history is rendered.
findings.impact_limit: History rendering can throw; no fund movement, remote unauthenticated path, or stored-byte corruption is established. In the privacy branch the history may additionally require its reveal action.

findings.title: Private scan loses session-only RPC selections
findings.condition: Production privateScanStore is enabled, current-tab endpoint settings are saved with session-only retention, and persisted settings remain readable. The integrity consequence additionally requires a usable primary, a chosen session-only secondary, and plan.useSecondary=true.
findings.impact_limit: The chosen independent secondary may be silently omitted. A session-only primary with no usable custom scan endpoint fails visibly and closed. Read denial/absent browser storage uses the in-memory fallback. No forged payment or fund loss is established.

current_main.qualification: Defect-specific persisted-settings private-scan path is absent; this is not a claim that the newer private-scan feature was integrated and fixed.

unique_code.qualification: Defect-specific persisted-settings private-scan path is absent; this is not a claim that the newer private-scan feature was integrated and fixed.

recovered_fixes.qualification: Defect-specific persisted-settings private-scan path is absent; this is not a claim that the newer private-scan feature was integrated and fixed.

tor.qualification: Defect-specific persisted-settings private-scan path is absent; this is not a claim that the newer private-scan feature was integrated and fixed.

findings.title: Thirty-day privacy count loses partial qualifier
findings.condition: The scan covers the recent seven-day interval but not the whole available thirty-day interval, while reporting both counts.
findings.impact_limit: The thirty-day count can be presented as complete when it is a lower bound. Spending authority is unaffected.

findings.title: RPC receipt identity and status are not fully validated
findings.condition: The selected RPC returns a receipt with missing/mismatched transactionHash or a parsed status outside the two defined outcomes.
findings.impact_limit: Payment outcome presentation can be attributed to inconsistent data. This does not establish chain-state forgery or theft. Both identity and status checks are required for fixed status.

findings.title: ERC20 simulation accepts malformed nonempty ABI bool
findings.condition: simulateCall is used with expectBool=true and receives nonempty syntactically valid hex that is not a canonical ABI boolean.
findings.impact_limit: The UI can omit its unavailable-simulation warning. The product already permits unavailable simulations with a warning; no direct unintended-transfer bypass is established.

findings.title: Sweep input edits do not revoke pending review
findings.condition: A user begins a sweep with a valid session, then changes destination, mode, or the review context while preparation/signing is awaiting completion.
findings.impact_limit: The earlier captured transaction context can continue despite changed visible inputs. This is stale consent, not arbitrary recipient injection. No fund-loss magnitude or live signing result is asserted.

findings.title: Page hiding does not revoke pending local imports
findings.condition: A local paste/image import remains pending when the page is hidden with no active camera.
findings.impact_limit: The consumer callback can receive content after the action lifetime should end. Downstream consumer checks can limit effects; no secret disclosure or unauthorized signing is established.

findings.title: parseUnits lacks runtime argument guards
findings.condition: A direct runtime caller violates the TypeScript amount/decimal-precision contract.
findings.impact_limit: The utility can throw or perform excessive work, but reviewed normal production callers use strings and configured precision. No network-controlled unbounded-precision path is established.

findings.title: Privacy WalletAttempts callers omit wallet
findings.condition: The privacy WalletAttempts implementation has journal entries, but its production Pay/Registry callers omit the optional wallet account/chain scope even after connection.
findings.impact_limit: History and its explicit-clear recovery action are unavailable. Duplicate-attempt protection remains active, and the current transaction view may still display a hash. No false success or theft is established.

findings.title: Rejected conflicting QR chunk refreshes idle expiry
findings.condition: An incomplete bounded multipart QR session receives a conflicting chunk before its existing idle deadline.
findings.impact_limit: Rejected input refreshes the deadline. Final payload integrity/authentication and storage bounds remain in force; no unbounded-storage or authentication bypass is established.

findings.title: Canonical arrays lack dense own-data validation
findings.condition: A direct JavaScript caller supplies a sparse, decorated, accessor-bearing, or otherwise malformed array to canonicalize.
findings.impact_limit: Unexpected canonical representations are possible at the API boundary. Strict parsed JSON supplies ordinary dense arrays; no reachable signature bypass is established. Descriptor snapshotting does not imply arbitrary proxy objects can never run any trap.

findings.title: Base64url decoder lacks runtime string guard
findings.condition: A direct runtime caller supplies a non-string decoder argument.
findings.impact_limit: Behavior/errors can be inconsistent, but the invoice-fragment entry point already checks string input. No external verification bypass is established.

findings.title: Merchant profile expiry lacks invalid-clock guard
findings.condition: The caller/environment supplies a non-finite or negative nowSec; some invalid clock values allow a correctly signed profile to pass without meaningful expiry evaluation.
findings.impact_limit: Clock control is a caller/environment prerequisite; no external clock-control path is established. Fixed status covers the explicit non-finite/negative-clock check.

findings.title: QR kind helpers lack complete runtime guards
findings.condition: A runtime caller supplies an out-of-domain kind/payload argument or a non-string property key.
findings.impact_limit: Normal reviewed callers use typed constants; no imported-QR route to privileged secret handling or key disclosure is established.

release.qualification: Own-key checks are present, but a runtime string check is missing; residual behavior requires malformed direct runtime input.

quick_hide.qualification: Own-key checks are present, but a runtime string check is missing; residual behavior requires malformed direct runtime input.

unique_code.qualification: Own-key checks are present, but a runtime string check is missing; residual behavior requires malformed direct runtime input.

findings.title: Multipart QR normalizes ill-formed Unicode
findings.condition: A direct multipart caller supplies text containing an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate.
findings.impact_limit: Encoded text may differ from caller input. Reviewed invoice/key producers emit structured encoded text; no valid signed-invoice/key corruption flow is established.

C1-A.observation: Idle lock awaits custody without suspension; the unrecoverable sole-copy branch returns with the seller session retained.

C1-B.observation: Ordinary secret access and guards check key-holder/revision presence without an idle suspension check.

C1-C.observation: Idle lock calls suspendSession synchronously before vault lock, view notification, or asynchronous custody finalization.

C1-D.observation: Privacy variant preserves the same synchronous authority suspension.

C1-E.observation: Ordinary APIs evaluate expiry and suspension; pre-lock revisions fail, while a separately named encrypted-backup-only guard permits retained recovery.

C2-A.observation: issuedAt has a positive-safe-integer check, without a representable JavaScript Date upper bound in seconds.

C2-B.observation: The optional-address receipt variant retains the same issue-time validation gap.

C2-C.observation: Authenticated archive import delegates issue-time validation to the receipt schema; the explicit Date-range bound applies only to archivedAt.

C2-D.observation: History renders receipt.issuedAt * 1000 through unguarded Date.toISOString.

C2-E.observation: Privacy-wrapped history retains the same unguarded issue-date rendering.

SN2-A.observation: Validated endpoint maps enter current app settings after session-only retention choices are registered.

SN2-B.observation: Privacy settings variant preserves the retention registration and current app-settings update.

SN2-C.observation: Current React settings retain the submitted maps while saveSettings writes the stripped persisted representation.

SN2-D.observation: An execution-settings change retains the full current maps then saves the stripped representation; UI-only privacy saves have a separate shortcut.

SN2-E.observation: loadSettings reads stored preferences only; saveSettings removes primary and secondary session-only URLs.

SN2-F.observation: Privacy preferences are separate, but execution-settings load still reads only storage and save strips session-only URLs.

SN2-G.observation: Private scanning prefers readable persisted settings. Missing primary fails visibly; an omitted secondary is skipped even when the plan permits its use.

SN2-H.observation: Privacy variant has the same persisted-settings preference and missing-secondary behavior.

SN2-J.observation: Older production services do not include privateScanStore.

SN2-K.observation: Older scan uses app.getSecondaryRpc directly; the defect-specific persisted-settings private path is absent.

SN1-A.observation: The shared partial flag checks from7 despite also reporting count30d.

SN1-B.observation: The shared partial flag checks the full available from30 range.

P1-A.observation: pollReceipt does not bind transactionHash and maps every parsed status other than one to reverted.

P1-B.observation: pollReceipt requires a valid matching transactionHash and an exactly zero-or-one status.

P2-A.observation: expectBool simulation rejects canonical false but treats other syntactically valid nonempty hex as ok.

P2-B.observation: Nonempty expectBool output must be one 32-byte word equal to zero or one; malformed output is unavailable, and empty legacy output is preserved.

P3-A.observation: UI guard does not bind destination/mode/review revision; destination remains editable and helpers receive no assertReviewCurrent capability.

P3-B.observation: Direct sweep checks seller-session identity before signing/handoff but cannot check the live UI review.

P3-C.observation: Live balance and quote scopes plus cancellation invalidate superseded reviews and pass assertReviewCurrent to submission helpers.

P3-D.observation: Direct submission checks the caller review capability alongside session identity immediately before signing and handoff.

P4-A.observation: Hidden-page handler cancels camera work only; visible omits document visibility and deliver calls the consumer before its cancellation check.

P4-B.observation: Hidden-page handler cancels pending local imports, visible checks document visibility, and deliver checks before calling the consumer.

P5-A.observation: parseUnits uses trim, BigInt precision, exponentiation and padding without runtime argument validation.

P5-B.observation: parseUnits checks string input and integer decimals in the closed range 0..36 before arithmetic.

PS1-A.observation: The optional wallet prop controls eligible rows and the explicit-clear action; absent wallet means no eligible history.

PS1-B.observation: Both production Pay render paths omit the wallet prop.

PS1-C.observation: Registry also renders WalletAttempts without the wallet prop.

PS1-D.observation: Experimental policy caller also omits wallet; this additional caller does not determine core reachability.

PS1-E.observation: Older component has no wallet-prop contract and directly renders available journal rows and clear controls, so the privacy regression is not present.

H1-A.observation: Assembler refreshes lastActivity before it rejects a conflicting chunk in an incomplete session.

H1-B.observation: Assembler refreshes lastActivity only after the conflict validation accepts the chunk.

H2-A.observation: Canonicalizer calls the input array map method without requiring dense own data properties.

H2-B.observation: Canonicalizer snapshots descriptors and validates a dense array with no extra own keys or accessor elements.

H3-A.observation: Decoder reads length and charCodeAt without an explicit runtime string guard.

H3-B.observation: Decoder rejects non-string runtime input before reading its length or allocating output.

H4-A.observation: Verifier evaluates signed-profile expiry using the caller clock without first rejecting non-finite or negative values.

H4-B.observation: Verifier rejects non-finite and negative caller clocks before parsing/signature work.

P6-A.observation: QR classification lacks own-key and runtime string checks.

P6-B.observation: Intermediate guards require own keys but still allow JavaScript property-key coercion of non-string arguments.

P6-C.observation: Complete guards require string values and own keys before classification.

P7-A.observation: Multipart encoding passes text directly to TextEncoder, which normalizes unpaired UTF-16 surrogates.

P7-B.observation: Multipart encoding rejects unpaired UTF-16 surrogates before TextEncoder.

quality_and_scope_qualifications: Historical/main wording in older finding files still applies to current main 773a94b: the c977b5d -> 773a94b diff contains documentation and portable-hosting-kit changes only.
Tor matches current main for every source blob used by this matrix. This statement is limited to the reviewed finding paths.
Recovered-fixes corrects many small boundaries but retains the original idle-lock and sweep-review implementation. Unique-code also retains those implementations.
Quick-hide is not a superset of completion: it retains the older RPC receipt validator and QR conflict-expiry order, and adds the WalletAttempts wiring regression.

SCAN-NET-02 needs readable persisted settings. Its Medium integrity consequence requires an otherwise usable primary, session-only secondary, and plan.useSecondary=true. The missing-primary case is visible fail-closed availability behavior.
QR kind guards are partial in release, quick-hide and unique-code. The older worker hash-only receipt fix is likewise partial but is outside these seven primary columns.

PUI-05, PUI-06, PUI-07 and CP-H02/03/04 must keep their direct-caller/environment prerequisites. Source presence alone is not proof of a remotely exploitable denial of service, signature bypass or key disclosure.
CUSTODY-02 remains in all seven snapshots and requires an authenticated reconciliation archive/history path; it is not an unauthenticated network finding.
No additional higher-severity claim was established by this independent applicability review. Severity labels are inherited from the scoped source findings with the conditions above retained.
